mentions.name: Automated Subtitle Translator
mentions.description: This AI-powered tool translates existing English subtitles by feeding both the subtitle text and a centre-weighted mono audio track extracted from the video file into an AI model, which produces the translated subtitles.
mentions.source_excerpt: an automated subtitle translator tool that can take both the existing English subtitles and a centre-weighted mono audio extracted from the video file and feed it to an AI

evidence.value: an automated subtitle translator tool that can take both the existing English subtitles and a centre-weighted mono audio extracted from the video file and feed it to an AI
